query:
SELECT
                c.id AS "store_customer_id?",
                c.alias AS "alias?",
                c.first_seen_at AS "first_seen_at?",
                c.last_seen_at AS "last_seen_at?",
                c.interaction_count AS "interaction_count?",
                u.display_name
            FROM coupon.users u
            LEFT JOIN coupon.store_customers c
                   ON c.user_id = u.id AND c.store_id = $1
            WHERE u.id = $2
